analytics.clean_lap_def: lap_time <= best*1.05 (incident=slow lap; peak-g is info only)

notes.lookahead: head-ORIENTATION (AirPods yaw) proxy for gaze, approximate, drifts; NOT eye-tracking.
notes.consistency: consistency/line stats use CLEAN laps only (incident laps flagged separately).

g_summary.note: Sustained lat/long g are vehicle-motion derived and clipped to realistic Sodi GT5 rental-kart bounds (~2 g lateral, ~1.2 g braking, ~0.4 g accel for a ~170 lb driver). peak_impact_g is a brief kerb/wall TRANSIENT on raw accel - not sustained cornering load.

audio.note: drift-corrected: audio.currentTime maps 1:1 to series t
